summary.intent: Check project progress and then gather implementation context for Phase 23 (Rust SDK Extraction) through a structured discussion to produce a CONTEXT.md that guides downstream research and planning agents.
summary.outcome: Progress check confirmed Phase 20 complete with Phases 21-23 remaining. Full Phase 23 context discussion completed, resulting in a committed CONTEXT.md capturing a 5-crate architecture (cipherbox-crypto, cipherbox-core, cipherbox-fuse, cipherbox-api-client, cipherbox-sdk) mirroring the TypeScript SDK structure.

repo: Rust desktop app has ~8,300 LOC across 50 files in apps/desktop/src-tauri/ with src/crypto/ (~2,500 LOC, 12 files), src/fuse/ (~3,500 LOC, 11 files), src/api/ + src/sync/ (~1,300 LOC)

All three platforms (macOS FUSE-T/SMB, Linux libfuse3, Windows WinFsp) are fully implemented — macOS and Linux share fuser-based callback code with #[cfg(target_os)] for mount/unmount differences, Windows has its own implementation in src/fuse/windows/
Cross-language test vectors already exist in crypto/tests.rs verifying byte-identical output between Rust and TypeScript implementations
Phase 19.1 explicitly punted Rust SDK extraction as out-of-scope — Phase 23 picks up that deferred work

The same openapi.json that feeds orval for TypeScript can feed a Rust code generator (openapi-generator or progenitor) to produce a typed cipherbox-api-client crate, eliminating hand-written src/api/ code

code.finding: Platform dispatch lives here — macOS and Linux share fuser-based FUSE callbacks with cfg(target_os) guards for mount options and unmount commands (fusermount3 -u on Linux)
Windows WinFsp FUSE implementation is a separate module rather than sharing the fuser-based code used by macOS/Linux
Cross-language test vectors exist here — these should be the foundation for the expanded parity testing strategy in Phase 23

workflow: The GSD progress workflow correctly identifies completed phases by counting PLAN.md vs SUMMARY.md files and routes to discuss-phase when no context exists
Codebase scout during discuss-phase can have gaps — the assistant initially misreported Linux FUSE as unimplemented; always verify assertions against actual file structure
The discuss-phase workflow carries forward decisions from prior CONTEXT.md files to avoid re-asking settled questions — Phase 19.1 CONTEXT.md was the key prior reference here

friction: Assistant initially incorrectly stated Linux FUSE was not yet implemented, requiring the user to correct it and triggering a re-verification step — codebase scout missed Linux implementation despite it existing in the same operations.rs file as macOS
open_items: Phase 21 (BYO-IPFS Node Support) and Phase 22 still need discussion/planning before Phase 23 work begins (or phases are being done out of order)
1 active debug session still open — review with /gsd:debug
CI matrix details for cross-platform FUSE testing deferred to researcher/planner
Exact split of IPNS record creation between cipherbox-crypto vs cipherbox-core was noted as borderline but resolved to mirror TS (put in core) — worth validating during implementation
